subject: Charged twice for my subscription
message: I can see two charges of €49 for this month on my card. I only have one subscription. Please refund the duplicate charge today.
notes: Clear duplicate charge and explicit refund request.

subject: Where can I download my invoice?
message: Hi, I need the invoice for last month's subscription for my accounting records. Where can I download it?

subject: Card charged after cancellation
message: I cancelled my plan last week but I was charged again this morning. I want the charge reversed.

subject: Payment failed but money is pending
message: The checkout said my payment failed, but my bank shows a pending charge. Should I try paying again?
notes: Payment status question; no explicit refund.

subject: Need to change billing details
message: Our company address changed and I need future invoices to show the new legal address and VAT number.

subject: Unexpected price increase
message: My monthly plan used to cost €29 and now I was charged €39. I don't understand why the amount changed.

subject: Dashboard shows a blank page
message: After logging in, the dashboard is completely blank in Chrome and Firefox. I cannot access any of my projects.

subject: CSV export fails
message: Every time I export a report as CSV I get an 'Internal Server Error'. Viewing reports works normally.
notes: Feature-specific bug; partial product access remains.

subject: Webhook events are delayed
message: Our webhook events are arriving 20 to 30 minutes late since this morning. This is breaking our automation.

subject: Mobile layout is broken
message: On my iPhone the settings page overlaps and I cannot tap the save button. Desktop works fine.
notes: User blocked from specific action on mobile.

subject: API returns 429 unexpectedly
message: We're receiving 429 errors after only a few requests. Our usage dashboard says we are well below the documented limit.

subject: Notification emails missing
message: I enabled email notifications but none are being delivered. In-app notifications still appear normally.

subject: I cannot reset my password
message: The password reset email arrives, but the link says it has already expired even when I click it immediately.

subject: Change my account email
message: I no longer use my old work address and want to move my account to my new email address.

subject: Two-factor authentication problem
message: I replaced my phone and no longer have access to my authenticator app. I cannot sign in to my account.

subject: Please delete my account
message: I would like to permanently delete my account and all profile information associated with it.

subject: Team member cannot accept invitation
message: I invited a colleague to our workspace, but the invite link says the invitation is invalid.

subject: Do you offer an annual plan?
message: We're evaluating the product for a 12-person team. Do you have annual pricing or volume discounts?

subject: Requesting an enterprise demo
message: Our engineering organization is considering your enterprise plan. Can we schedule a demo next week?

subject: Need a quote for 80 users
message: Can you send us a quote for approximately 80 seats including SSO and priority support?

subject: Does the Pro plan include API access?
message: I'm comparing your Pro and Business plans before subscribing. Does Pro include API access and higher rate limits?

subject: Partnership proposal
message: We run a developer newsletter and would like to discuss a possible content partnership with your company.

subject: Security questionnaire
message: Our procurement team needs your SOC 2 report and a completed vendor security questionnaire before approval.

subject: Feature request: dark mode
message: It would be great to have a true dark mode in the dashboard. Is this on your roadmap?
notes: Product feedback rather than support incident.

subject: Press inquiry
message: I'm a journalist writing about AI developer tools and would like to speak with someone from your team.

subject: Subscription issue and account stopped working
message: Something happened with my subscription yesterday and now parts of my account don't work. I'm not sure whether the payment caused it.
notes: Intentionally ambiguous between billing, account and technical.

subject: Can't use product after plan change
message: I upgraded this morning, the payment went through, but premium features are still locked and I cannot continue my work.
notes: Ambiguous billing vs technical/account entitlement issue.

subject: Login problem after company card expired
message: Our company card expired last week. Today I was logged out and now I cannot access the workspace. I don't know if the two things are related.
notes: Ambiguous account access vs billing state.

subject: Plan says active but API is disabled
message: The billing page says our plan is active and paid, but API access suddenly stopped with a message saying the feature is unavailable.

subject: Need help with upgrade and broken settings
message: I want to upgrade our workspace, but the settings page keeps throwing an error when I open the billing section. Can someone help?
notes: Ambiguous sales/billing/technical ticket; ideal human-review candidate.
